anomalies.description: A soldier in combat gear appears to be engaged in a dynamic confrontation, moving aggressively behind cover with weapon raised (f5–f6). However, no direct physical contact or reciprocal action from another party is visible; the motion blur and context suggest combat but not confirmed mutual physical combat per definition.

A soldier is shown aiming a rifle with a scope; the close-up on the eye and weapon (f10) strongly suggests active aiming, and the preceding frame (f9) shows the weapon raised in firing posture. While no muzzle flash or bullet impact is visible, the sustained aiming posture across frames supports an imminent or ongoing shooting event.

A large, violent explosion erupts in an urban street, producing a massive fireball, dense smoke plume, and a powerful debris wave that lifts and scatters rubble and dust. The blast is centered near a vehicle and propagates outward rapidly.; The explosion's aftermath continues with sustained expansion of the smoke cloud and ongoing ejection of debris; secondary combustion and turbulent mixing of smoke and fire are visible, indicating residual explosive energy release.; The explosion subsides into a large, rising smoke column with diminishing fire visibility; debris settles and the scene transitions to post-blast destruction, including damaged infrastructure and lingering particulate suspension.
A large, violent explosion erupts behind and around a person in a bomb suit, generating a massive expanding dust and debris cloud that engulfs the subject over the entire sequence.

A large, violent explosion erupts from the ground, generating a massive, rapidly expanding dust and debris cloud that engulfs a vehicle lying on its side. The blast appears to originate near or beneath the vehicle, with visible ejection of soil and fragments in early frames (f0–f2), followed by sustained turbulent cloud expansion and settling over the subsequent frames.

A large, sustained dust and debris cloud erupts and expands rapidly from ground level, engulfing a dark, low-profile object (likely a vehicle or equipment) lying on its side. The cloud shows characteristic turbulent expansion, ejection of particulates, and ground disturbance consistent with a high-energy blast event occurring at or just before t=64.0s and continuing through the sequence.
